description:
Fulcrum is a cloud manufacturing operations system for small and mid-sized discrete manufacturers, including CNC machine shops, sheet metal fabricators, and aerospace and defense suppliers. It combines ERP, MRP and manufacturing execution in one web application, from quoting and planning through scheduling, shop-floor tracking, quality, shipping and invoicing.

Archie, the AI built into Fulcrum, answers questions about a customer's live shop data, takes actions on it, and builds custom pages and tools. Customers can also connect their own AI assistants to the same data tools through the Fulcrum MCP server, within each user's permissions. Archie's AI models are hosted in Microsoft Azure Government with the rest of the offering, so prompts to Archie and the shop data it reads stay in Azure Government; a customer's own assistant runs wherever the customer chooses.

Customers reach the service through a web browser, a REST API and MCP.

description:
Globality's core application, the Globality Platform, is a software as a service ('SaaS') application that is accessible to end users through their web browser. The application can intelligently guide users in creating project briefs ('RFPs / Request for Proposals') or proposals, by leveraging AI and ML to suggest answers, automatically scope projects, analyze user input, and match clients with suitable providers and support the approval process. The Globality Platform enables processing of the following tasks related to the procurement process:
 - Capturing data from clients and providers to automatically build out comprehensive project briefs and proposals
 - Intelligently analyzing user input to identify key components and match clients with providers
 - Providing secure communication channels between clients and matched providers, as well as with Globality support personnel
 - Providing learning systems to help users become self-sufficient on the platform
 - Enabling clients to rate providers using common criteria
 - Authenticating and authorizing users to ensure access is strictly controlled
 - Supporting configurable workflows to streamline procurement processes and make it specific to each client use case
 - Providing approval flows to users, include ways to require nondisclosure agreements ('NDAs') prior to submissions
 - Providing data reporting to end users through a variety of formats
 - Integrating with external systems, including SAP and Oracle
 Projects are tracked throughout the procurement cycle, from initial brief creation to the final awarding of a provider proposal. Access is managed through the web browser, and all user data is encrypted at rest, in transit, and fully protected throughout its data lifecycle.

With SmartHub, organizations can reduce manual administrative tasks, improve operational visibility, and provide 24/7 controlled access to IVM Smart Solutions without requiring constant onsite support. description: MaintainX is a mobile and cloud based Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) deployed in a FedRAMP Moderate-authorized environment dedicated for U.S. government use. The system provides work order management, preventive maintenance scheduling, asset tracking, standardized procedure management, realtime team communication, and reporting/analytics. All services are delivered through a secure SaaS platform hosted in AWS GovCloud, with backend microservices orchestrated on Amazon EKS. Security measures include container hardening (CIS/STIG baselines), end to end TLS 1.2+ encryption, role based access via a dedicated fed only identity provider with CAC/PIV support, continuous monitoring and anomaly detection, malware scanning for uploaded files, configuration drift detection, and vulnerability scanning. The authorization boundary includes all production services, storage, monitoring and logging pipelines. This deployment is available exclusively to members of the U.S. government community, including federal, state, local, and tribal agencies, as well as authorized federal contractors.

description: Partos is an AI-native operating system for the U.S. aerospace and defense supply chain, unifying prime contractors, suppliers, and sub-tier vendors in a single Government Community Cloud environment on AWS GovCloud (US). Partos accelerates supplier onboarding and vetting with continuous KYB, KYC, AML, and OFAC screening and compliance monitoring across ITAR, EAR export controls, and DFARS. It delivers end-to-end, multi-tier supply chain risk visibility and active risk management, and orchestrates domestic and international supplier payments—ACH, RTP, and wires—with compliance tracing preserved throughout. The platform leverages export control regulatory frameworks (including ITAR, EAR, and CUI) to automatically enforce data access boundaries. Access is dynamically controlled based on variables like nationality and geographic location, ensuring continuous compliance at every layer. A unified data ontology and pipeline layer powers Partos AI, a multi-agent, multimodal system in which specialized agents collaborate to answer questions and act across the entire supply chain. Partos AI works both reactively and proactively—agents operate as an extension of your team, monitoring, surfacing risks, and advancing work 24/7 rather than only responding on request. Partos AI is model-agnostic (open-source and proprietary), extensible via a no-code workflow builder and REST, WebSocket, SSE, and MCP interfaces, and embeddable in any enterprise application. It supports multi- and single-tenancy, multiple IdPs and SSO, SCIM provisioning, and granular role-, group-, and permission-based access. Customers retain full ownership and exportability of their data and the AI's memory.

product: Contract Management Planning and Surveillance System
description:
COMPASS is a contract execution management system designed for the Department of Defense (DoD) customers to manage contract lifecycles from award to completion. The system is categorized as Moderate (M) under the Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) security categorization, aligning with the FedRAMP Moderate baseline for cloud services. COMPASS is hosted on Microsoft Azure Government, a platform-as-a-service (PaaS) environment, which holds a FedRAMP High Provisional Authority to Operate (P-ATO) from the Joint Authorization Board (JAB).

System Overview
COMPASS provides DoD customers with tools to track, document, and store contract files throughout the contract execution phase. Users can generate customizable reports on contract statuses and activities, with the option to receive automated email notifications based on a configurable schedule.

The application is accessed via a web interface secured with Transport Layer Security (TLS) 1.2 or higher. DoD Common Access Card (CAC) authentication, utilizing X.509 certificates, ensures secure access for users. The back-end administrative access is protected through Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) and Duo Federal multi-factor authentication (MFA) using FIPS 140-2 validated hard token YubiKeys.

Infrastructure and Hosting
COMPASS is hosted on the Microsoft Azure Government cloud infrastructure, inheriting numerous FedRAMP security controls from the platform. Microsoft Azure Government manages all underlying infrastructure, ensuring compliance with stringent security requirements. The scope of inherited and partially inherited controls is outlined in Microsoft's documentation on Azure services’ audit scopes for FedRAMP and DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (SRG).

Security and Compliance
COMPASS implements robust security features, including logical separation of customer data within unique databases, ensuring that customers and vendors are isolated from each other’s data. Standard Technology, Inc. enforces role-based access control (RBAC) policies for both administrative staff and customer users. Azure DevOps is integrated with a commercial Azure subscription for managing the system's development, with code changes being deployed into the Azure Government environment.

The system utilizes a variety of external services for security and functionality:

Tenable Nessus Pro: Vulnerability and compliance scanning.
Microsoft Updates: OS and antivirus updates for COMPASS servers.
HCL AppScan: Dynamic code analysis.
Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP): Configuration compliance scanning.
Microsoft DevOps: Logic Apps service for creating work items triggered by security alerts.
SMTPS: Email notifications during outages and security alerts.
Naval Observatory Server: Time synchronization.
Duo Federal MFA: Provides multi-factor authentication.
Google DNSSEC: Ensures Domain Name System Security Extensions (DNSSEC).
Azure Managed Services
COMPASS leverages several managed services within Azure to enhance operational efficiency and security, including:

Azure SQL Managed Instances
Microsoft Power BI
Azure Web Apps
Microsoft Sentinel
Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF)
Microsoft Defender for Cloud
COMPASS meets the requirements of the FedRAMP Moderate baseline and leverages the security capabilities of the Azure Government PaaS to provide DoD customers with a secure, reliable contract management platform.

description:
Boltline is a multi-tenant manufacturing execution and operations SaaS platform. Federal customers use Boltline to manage engineering-to-production workflows, including parts, bills of materials, inventory, work plans, orders, integrations, attachments, and auditable workflow activity.

Boltline may store, process, or transmit federal customer data including user and organization records, technical product metadata, part and BOM data, work instructions, inventory and order records, files and attachments, connector payloads, integration metadata, security events, and audit logs. Depending on customer use, this data may include controlled unclassified information. Boltline is not intended to store classified information.

The primary FedRAMP assessment boundary is the Stoke-operated Boltline SaaS production environment in AWS GovCloud (`prod-govcloud`).

description:
USU IT Asset Management (CCITAMS) is an IT asset management tool. The solution supports both hardware and software, virtual or physical assets, on-premises or in the cloud. For each asset, CC IT Asset Management System contains business information such as product, item, procurement and maintenance contracts and costs; technical data such as type of asset, inventory number, and tickets relating to the incident, problem, or change management; and organizational data including the people responsible for each asset or who use the asset.

In addition, CCITAMS system leverages IT-CNP, Inc GovDataHosting Cloud Platform (GCP) Network infrastructure and support services. CCITAMS inherits and shares controls from the hosting FedRAMP certified Cloud Service Provider, IT-CNP GovDataHosting Cloud Platform (GCP). IT-CNP’s GCP CSP offering has been FedRAMP Authorized since 4/3/2019, Package ID F1303221956.  

IT-CNP’s GCP certified support personnel manage the underlying components of cloud datacenter infrastructure (physical security, redundant power/cooling, network, storage, physical  hypervisor servers, access/authentication, operating system, backup, disaster recovery and security compliance). 

IT-CNP personnel manage the security and continuous monitoring infrastructure software components on each CCITAMS virtual server, including antivirus/anti-malware and Log Aggregation agents. In addition to technical tasking, for CCITAMS, IT-CNP manages all security compliance related tasking on behalf of CCITAMS, including system hardening, system security compliance documentation, periodic tasking activities and disaster recovery services in support of CCITAMS Authorization to Operate (ATO).
